stations.title: Sefton
stations.say: How did a test with no answer pass?

stations.title: Your runner
stations.text: Moves on before a promise settles.

stations.title: Workshop screen
stations.text: The supplier test fails after a time limit.

captions: Some of Sefton's tests now wait, and one waits for a supplier that never answers.
Today the runner moves on before they finish, so the supplier test passes.
You teach the runner to wait, in order, with a limit, in three tasks.
Now the supplier test fails after half a second, with a reason.
Tests that wait are judged by how they end, and none can wait for ever.
